lines: Koi aarzoo nahin hai, koi mudda'a nahin hai
couplets.en: I have no wish, nothing to ask for.

lines: Koi aarzoo nahin hai, koi mudda'a nahin hai
couplets.en: I have no wish, nothing to ask for.

lines: Gham-e-aashiqui salamat, mere dil mein kya nahin hai
couplets.en: May love's sorrow stay with me, for what does my heart lack?

lines: Kahan jaam-e-gham ki talkhi, kahan zindagi ka darmaan
couplets.en: What has the bitter cup of sorrow to do with a cure for life?

lines: Mujhe woh dawa mili hai jo meri dawa nahin hai
couplets.en: The remedy I was given could never heal me.

lines: Mujhe woh dawa mili hai jo meri dawa nahin hai
couplets.en: The remedy I was given could never heal me.

lines: Tumhein keh diya sitamgar, yeh qusoor tha zabaan ka
couplets.en: I called you cruel, but it was my tongue that slipped.

lines: Mujhe tum maaf kar do, mera dil bura nahin hai
couplets.en: Forgive me, I meant you no harm.

lines: Mujhe tum maaf kar do, mera dil bura nahin hai
couplets.en: Forgive me, I meant you no harm.

lines: Yeh udaas udaas chehre, yeh haseen haseen tabassum
couplets.en: Such sorrowful faces, such lovely smiles.

lines: Teri anjuman mein shayad koi aaina nahin hai
couplets.en: Perhaps there is no mirror where your guests gather.

lines: Teri anjuman mein shayad koi aaina nahin hai
couplets.en: Perhaps there is no mirror where your guests gather.

lines: Meri aankh ne tujhe bhi, ba-khuda Shakeel, dekha
couplets.en: God knows, Shakeel, I saw you too.

lines: Main samajh raha tha mujh sa koi doosra nahin hai
couplets.en: I had thought there was no one else like me.

lines: Koi aarzoo nahin hai, koi mudda'a nahin hai
couplets.en: I have no wish, nothing to ask for.
